input_messages.content: Hi, I need to exchange a T-shirt I bought. It’s just too big for me. I’m hoping to get the same one, just a size smaller. Can you help with that?
My name is Sofia Thomas. My email is sofia.thomas3019@example.com. I’m not sure about the order ID right now—do I really need it? I just want to swap it for a smaller size.
I don’t have the order ID handy, but my zip code is 10027. I really hope this works, because I just want to get the right size.
Oh, maybe I used my other email. Try sofia.thomas3069@example.com. My name spelling and zip code are correct, so I’m not sure what else it could be. I just want to get this sorted out.
I don’t have the order ID, but I ordered the T-shirt about two weeks ago. It’s a cotton T-shirt—I really like how it feels, just wish it fit better. That’s all I remember about the order.

I’d like to exchange it for a size L instead of XXL. If possible, I’d prefer the T-shirt in black, but I want to keep the same cotton material and crew neck style. As for payment, just use my PayPal if there’s any price difference. I just hope this goes smoothly.
Yes, that’s all correct. Please go ahead and process the exchange. I just want to get the right size and color this time.

Thank you for your help. I’ll look out for the email. Hopefully, this time it fits better. That’s all I needed. 

###STOP###
